{{Quote|A partial message was intercepted in a diplomatic packet from the Chairman of Utapau.|[[Anakin Skywalker]] to the [[Jedi High Council]]|<ref name="Episode III">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
The '''Chairman of Utapau''', was the [[Head of State/Legends|head of state]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]. The chairman headed the [[Utapaun Committee/Legends|Utapaun Committee]], which included the [[Master of Port Administration|Masters of Port Administration]], who each led Utapau's [[City/Legends|cities]].<ref name="NETGAS" /> At the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], a diplomatic packet from the chairman of Utapau was intercepted by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Clone Intelligence/Legends|Clone Intelligence]], confirming the presence of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] on the world.<ref name="Episode III" />
